rationale.automation-bias: Capable practitioners over-rely on AI, eroding skills and critical thinking
rationale.quality-debt: AI code bloat, tech debt, unmaintainable growth reported focally
rationale.provenance-auditability: Participants demand AI-action histories, edit logs, disclosure for accountability
rationale.hitl-workflow: Four-stage workflow documents human review/debug/approval control gates
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Review/debugging bottleneck; no firewall stops bad code reaching production
rationale.org-governance: Accountability, roles, org policy, disclosure norms discussed focally
rationale.survey-input: Rich adoption/practice findings across roles inform org survey
rationale.non-developer: Designers, PMs, researchers vibe-code beyond professional developers
rationale.assistive: Inline Cursor completions/snippet edits accepted piecewise
rationale.agentic: Lovable/Bolt generate full prototypes/apps reviewed at artifact granularity
rationale.steering: Documented prompting strategies (decomposition, stepwise) as contribution
rationale.risk-quality: Verbose, bloated, unmaintainable AI code treated substantively
rationale.risk-security: Credential leakage, missing security reviews, compliance constraints focal
rationale.risk-ip: Copyright/IP unease and attribution ownership treated substantively
